frame: Robot1 EKSEN1 installed frame -- CAD millimetres, Z up, rail along X
note: Source of truth for the native->installed transform baked into each Otokar GLB by convert.py. build_otokar_meshes.sh reads it; write_placements.mjs copies it to client/public/meshes/otokar/placements.json beside the meshes. Matrices are row-major 4x4 in mm.

entries.provenance: IDENTITY. EKSEN1 defines the installed frame; its own subassembly Shapes already carry their assembly placements.
entries.evidence: 1_Eksen_SYM (file root) placement is identity; the rail modules land at Y 2757.4..3563.9 and the carriage at X -12544.7..-11584.7, which is where the cell drawings put them.

entries.provenance: Placement of 2_Eksen_Sabit_SYM (the axis-2 column) inside Robot1_EKSEN1.stp -- 180 deg about Z plus t=(-10738.384, -0.108, 0).
entries.evidence: EKSEN2's root 2_Eksen_SYM has an IDENTITY placement and all its children sit at x~1500, y~-2980 -- the column's own master frame. The column's base plate (2_Eksen_Taban_Plaka_SYM) bottom face lands on the carriage plate (1_Eksen_Robot_Plakasi_SYM) top face to 0.40 mm under this matrix, with the 450x450 base fully inside the 950x714 plate.

entries.provenance: Same matrix as EKSEN2: EKSEN3 is exported in the same master frame, so it needs no transform relative to EKSEN2.
entries.evidence: BRep surface distance from EKSEN2's 2_Eksen_Robot_Plakasi_SYM to EKSEN3's Ic_Konstruksiyon_SYM_rev2 is 0.000 mm in NATIVE coordinates, with identical closest points (1507.0, -3216.8, -502.7). Two separately exported files cannot touch exactly unless they share a frame.

entries.provenance: NOT DERIVABLE FROM THE EXPORTS -- DECLARED ASSUMPTION.
entries.evidence: Robot1_EKSEN5.stp contains no camera instance (0 hits scanning for Kamera/Blaze/Basler/D455/DT35), and Robot2_Kamera.stp is modelled centred on its own origin, so no upstream placed instance exists to read a matrix from. The head is positioned at render time by CAMERA_MOUNT in OtokarGantryRobot.js, which hangs it below the axis-5 reducer. That is an assumption, not a measurement, and needs a figure from Otokar.
